brief: 7 tools that turn one engineer into a team. Names, urls, why each matters.

slots.title: 1. GitHub, the codebase
slots.body: Host code, review PRs, and automate CI/CD so you ship like a full engineering team.

slots.title: 2. Vercel, the deployer
slots.body: Preview every push and deploy globally in seconds without waiting on an ops teammate.

slots.title: 3. Linear, the planner
slots.body: Plan sprints, track bugs, and prioritize tasks with the speed of a dedicated product manager.

slots.title: 4. Figma, the designer
slots.body: Draft UI, prototype flows, and hand off specs without hiring a visual designer.

slots.title: 5. Supabase, the backend
slots.body: Spin up Postgres, auth, and APIs in minutes to skip hiring a platform engineer.

slots.title: 6. Slack, the HQ
slots.body: Centralize alerts, client messages, and daily standups so nothing slips through the cracks.
